title: Greg NDE 42
content:
The first few times I died and went through the void/curtain/wall that divides mortals with heaven- I saw a light and an old friend. All I was told, was that it was not my time. It was as if I was in a room w/no lights, sounds or feelings and all of a sudden, a white light and a shadow appeared that told me that it was not my time. This happened several times, maybe 5 times. The last time it happened I felt awake on the operating room table- I could hear the nurse and the doctor, the heart machine. I heard a female voice say we're losing him. Then I felt as if my soul> had been grabbed and pulled upwards to the ceiling. I was floating, I tried to look back- but that is not allowed. The sounds of the OR slowly faded- as if someone was turning down the volume control, slowly. I felt scared, but had a strange feeling of comfort or being told to be calm. I went through a dark tunnel where the light slowly became brighter. Then a shadow appeared- an old friend told me that it was not my time and then things went black/gone/etc. I somehow figured out that the shadow was a friend who died 5 years earlier. I am glad to see that he made it to heaven, he deserved it.

arrival.other_being_detail: A "shadow" identified as an "old friend" who "died 5 years earlier" and told him "it was not my time."

environment.environment_other_detail: Described a void/curtain/wall; like being in a room with no lights, sounds, or feelings; then a white light appeared.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Repeated episodes described as "several times, maybe 5 times" involving a void/curtain/wall and being told "it was not my time."
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Earlier episodes described as void/curtain/wall with light and a shadow; last episode included OBE in OR, then tunnel with light, then shadow friend message, then black.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: The void/curtain/wall phase with light and a shadow/old friend telling him "it was not my time" occurred several times ("maybe 5 times").

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Stated he "died" multiple times ("several times, maybe 5 times") and repeatedly encountered a void/curtain/wall with a white light and a shadow that said "it was not my time." Also reported "I tried to look back- but that is not allowed."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "It was as if I was in a room w/no lights, sounds or feelings"; "a white light and a shadow appeared that told me that it was not my time"; "my soul had been grabbed and pulled upwards to the ceiling"; "I tried to look back- but that is not allowed"; "I went through a dark tunnel where the light slowly became brighter."
